messages:
Elena Park: Quick heads-up — SilverLine wants to move to a 9-month renewal instead of 12, still requesting Net30 billing and Dedicated capacity. Procurement says they9ll issue a PO but need our vendor code first. Can someone own?
Ravi Patel: I can take point. Need final seat count and confirm Dedicated sizing (they mentioned a small burst buffer). Do we have usage this quarter?
Noah Green: Usage down slightly. Last quarter avg was ~85 active seats, they9re asking for 100 seats provisioned. Dedicated pool for that size is fine. Note: Dedicated lead time ~10 business days to allocate.
Ava Morales: From pricing: if they shorten to 9mo we need to adjust proration. Proposed: keep monthly unit rates but apply a one-time 1.5% term concession if PO arrives within 7 days. Finance wants a Net30 credit check; otherwise ask for 30% upfront.
Elena Park: Customer prefers no upfront. Can we offer conditional concession as Ava suggests? Also procurement will e-sign. They included sample PO reference: SL-PO-2026-77 and want billing entity to be Redwood Inference, Inc.
Ravi Patel: OK, I'll ask procurement to include SL-PO-2026-77 and confirm they9ll route to DocuSign. @BillingBot please confirm vendor code request path.
BillingBot: Vendor code process: submit vendor form to finance with PO reference and W-9. Estimated processing 2 business days after submission. Email billing@redwood.com.
Noah Green: Legal flagged two small redlines: a request to add an EU data residency clause and a request to lower our liability cap. We generally accept the EU clause from our template; liability change needs approval from legal leadership if cap increases >2x.
Ava Morales: Pricing signoff contingent on liability staying at standard. If they insist, escalate. Also confirm seat count (100) and Dedicated + burst on the quote. I'll update the quote PDF with conditional concession language.
Elena Park: I'll ask the customer to sign the quote and confirm PO ETA. Can someone prep the DocuSign envelope?
DocuSign-Bot: DocuSign envelope draft created: envelope_id=env_0f9d2a, assigned to procurement@silverline.com. Status: draft.
Ravi Patel: Sent vendor-code request template to Elena. Elena please attach signed quote + PO when ready. I'll follow up with procurement and nudge for signature this week.
Noah Green: If we get signed PO by 2026-04-05 we can schedule Dedicated pool activation for 2026-04-20. Otherwise activation slips into late April.
Ava Morales: Updated quote uploaded: https://files.redwood/silverline/quote-v3.pdf (includes 1.5% conditional concession and seat count 100).
Elena Park: Customer replied: PO will be routed via DocuSign, expects to sign by 2026-04-03. They asked if Net30 approval can be confirmed — procurement requires a billing-vendor-code attachment.
BillingBot: Action: submit vendor form to finance with PO ref SL-PO-2026-77 and attach customer W-9. Reply will include vendor code.
Ravi Patel: Great. Action items: (1) Elena to collect signed quote and PO, (2) BillingBot/finance to issue vendor code, (3) Noah to lock Dedicated schedule after receipt, (4) Legal to review the two redlines (EU clause OK, liability escalate if needed).
Elena Park: Copy — I'll post signed docs here when received and mark as closed. :white_check_mark:
DocuSign-Bot: Envelope sent: envelope_id=env_0f9d2a, status=sent to procurement@silverline.com.
Elena Park: Received confirmation from procurement that envelope is in their queue. Expected sign date 2026-04-03. Thanks all.
Ava Morales: Noted. Finance, please confirm Net30 credit approval as soon as vendor code is issued so we can finalize billing terms.
BillingBot: Vendor code request submitted to finance with PO SL-PO-2026-77 and W-9 attached. Finance ETA 48 hours.
Noah Green: Standing by to schedule Dedicated once we have the signed PO and vendor code.
Elena Park: Closing loop: once vendor code is back, I9ll confirm activation date and update the customer. Thanks team!
